core_world: Original fictional Kıyıyaka district; residential, market, park, waterfront.
Isometric projection and inverse picking, bounded follow camera and zoom, stable depth sorting, occluder fade/culling.
Swept circle collision; graph/A* paths; no diagonal corner cutting; unreachable fallback; bounded path requests.
Separate directed lane graph with signals, reservations, parking, speed limits, pedestrian crossings and deadlock recovery.
Movement, animations, keyboard and click controls, buildings with real interior scenes and correct return portal.
Inventory unique ownership, capacity/weight, telephone apps, map and mission HUD.
Day/night, calendar, clear/cloud/rain/wind, pause/tab-hidden pause, 0.5x/1x/2x speeds.
core_systems: Character appearance/background/traits; point budget; physics/mind/social/self-control; six 0–100 skills with daily XP cap.
Work applications, shifts, payroll, promotions, resignation and business stock; no overlapping shifts.
Integer money with double-entry conserved transfers, explicit system accounts, atomic purchase, loans matched to assets/liabilities, bounded interest and rent/property contracts.
Directed relationships, trust/affection/respect/fear/resentment/loyalty; event-grounded private knowledge, bounded memory with source/confidence.
Adult consensual romance, marriage/separation, household budget and capacity; validated family graph, guardianship and inheritance.
Courses with attendance, fees and prerequisites; certificates unlock jobs.
Three original factions with membership, leader, treasury, bounded territory influence, loyalty and persistent betrayal memory.
Combat telegraph/active/recovery, light/heavy attacks, block/dodge/surrender, stamina, injury and clinic recovery; frame-rate-independent damage.
Crime evidence and witnesses, reported knowledge, wanted state, pursuit/escape/surrender, separate justice outcomes; no omniscient police or automatic evidence-free convictions.
Business crisis affects real jobs/wages/output, debt and relationships; player choices operate on same state; viable legal progression and distress recovery path.
Causal missions derived from unresolved world facts; valid reachable actors/locations, reserved rewards/participants, deadlines, rejection/failure/cancel paths and exactly-once rewards.
architecture: Strict TS ESM with domain free of DOM/render/storage imports.
One authoritative worker; read-only rendering projection; separate UI state.
10 Hz fixed simulation step, integer tick, deterministic order and versioned RNG; command IDs deduplicate at tick boundary.
Cap catch-up at 5 ticks/frame; controlled slow mode; render never advances authoritative state.
No Math.random, Date.now, LLM, render timing in authoritative state.
Worker crash/context loss pause safely and preserve last valid snapshot.
Separate sim/render/UI/IPC instrumentation; lazy scoped route/assets.
persistence: Isolated tariklab-social-engine IndexedDB; three manual slots plus autosave.
Versioned checksum envelopes, atomic new revision/pointer promotion, previous verified revision retained.
Pure sequential migrations on copies; reject future schemas; preserve old games namespaces.
Import/export; copy/delete slots; quota/interrupted-write/corruption recovery; journal validation/quarantine.
Browser closed means simulation stops; optional catch-up only explicit recorded input.
quality_evidence: 60 exact acceptance IDs (38 P0,22 P1); additional source-document requirements remain in scope.
365-day repeated hash and ledger checks; save at day 180 then continue with equal result.
All 10 jobs and places; 20 event types including unmet prerequisites/reject/fail/save/reward branches.
100 portal transitions; 100 save roundtrips; 10000 accounting transactions; combat at 30/60 FPS.
Chromium/Firefox/WebKit critical gameplay, console/trace/video/screenshots, responsive/keyboard/200% zoom and context/worker fault tests.
Two separate 30-minute real human playtests mandatory; automated browser control does not satisfy this evidence type.
30-minute frame trace p95 <=33.3ms P0, 60-minute long tasks <=5% P1, two-hour controlled-GC heap slope <=1MB/min P1.
Existing TarikLab/TC SIM/Boardworld/Racon regressions and unchanged save namespaces.
Production provider ID/alias/commit SHA matching, actual live new/legacy browser smoke and rollback rehearsal.
